import gzip,json,math
from fractions import Fraction as F
r=json.loads(gzip.open('data/b681_epstein_zeros_narrowed.json.gz').read())['rows']
g=sorted([F(x['im']) for x in r]+[F(x['im']) for x in r if x['kind']=='OFF'])
print('points in the upper half (ON + OFF + partners):',len(g),'; lowest ordinate',float(g[0]),'; highest',float(g[-1]))
# windows (t,t+1] wholly in 0<t, t+1<=150: the count is maximal just below an ordinate
best=None; worst=None
for i,gi in enumerate(g):
    if gi+1>150: continue
    c=sum(1 for x in g if gi<=x<gi+1)
    t=float(gi)  # t just below gi
    m=10*math.log(t+3)-c
    if best is None or c>best[0]: best=(c,float(gi))
    if worst is None or m<worst[0]: worst=(m,float(gi),c)
print('largest window count N(t,t+1] with t+1<=150:',best)
print('narrowest margin 10 log(|t|+3) - N over those windows:',worst)
# A0 the list itself carries: max N/log(|t|+3)
a=max(sum(1 for x in g if gi<=x<gi+1)/math.log(float(gi)+3) for gi in g if gi+1<=150)
print('the list own A0 (max N/log(t+3)):',round(a,4))
print('ordinates in (149,150]:',[float(x) for x in g if 149<x<=150])
print('windows straddling 150: t in (149,150): count from the list at most', max(sum(1 for x in g if t<x<=150) for t in [149+k/1000 for k in range(1000)]))
"
